LTO NOx is calculated at each mode's own off-design point: the emissions index comes from the NOx severity parameter (P3, T3 and humidity) times 32 g/kg, the index at severity 1 for your combustor technology (32 g/kg is a conventional rich-burn combustor).

At approach, taxi/idle a compressor works past its calculated surge line (see the fan and HPC maps): with these stage values the design would need more surge margin there, for example a variable-area bypass nozzle or handling bleed.
Noise is component source levels, not certification EPNdB.
